en: Black‑and‑white street view of a mid‑20th‑century town scene. A three‑storey corner building with shops at street level and apartments above stands along an unpaved or lightly paved road. Several people are visible on the sidewalk and near parked vehicles, including an older car and a truck. A bicycle leans against a low wall. A decorative streetlamp and trees or forest appear in the background. Text printed in the image identifies the location as Lensmannsbygget in Elverums leir and credits the photographer/publisher E. Syringen in Elverum.
